scenario: Route important prepared work through a fixed candidate, separated implementation, and new-context criterion review while bypassing routine work.
limitations: Five response-only candidate samples do not prove implicit routing, product quality, or permission isolation.
The isolated implementer produced the expected candidate, but the final fresh evaluator never completed the required before-and-after readback because its wrapper failed.
Root-side read-only checks proved the fixture result, but they cannot substitute for the required no-history evaluator verdict.
The shared model family, filesystem, and tool permissions limit evaluator independence.
